rationale: The reported call is the intentional, read-only vswhere.exe tool-discovery probe.
ARX passes a fixed argument vector with shell=False; no user-controlled string is interpreted by a command shell.
The executable must exist at the conventional Visual Studio Installer path before it is invoked.
ARX runs asInvoker, and the probe does not cross an elevation or privileged-process boundary.
The probe output is treated as discovery input and candidate paths must exist before ARX reports a tool provider.
residual_limitation: ProgramFiles(x86) is obtained from the process environment, which the launching user can alter. ARX already treats command-visible executables as same-user discovery targets; a future hardening pass may derive this location through the Windows Known Folder API and independently verify publisher identity.
gate_policy: Only this exact rule and normalized repository path may be accepted. Any additional Semgrep ERROR, an engine error, or a stale reviewed identity fails the automatic gate.
